name: able-to-plan
description: See and update your Able to Plan tasks, appointments, Someday list and study sessions in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Able to Plan is a personal planner for students and working people. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask about your plans in plain language: "What's on my plate today?", "Do I have time for sport on Thursday?" or "Which reminders are still open?". Or let ChatGPT help you plan: "Add 'call the dentist' to Friday", "Put my biology test on Thursday in my agenda" or "Plan three study sessions for that test".

What ChatGPT can read:
- Tasks and appointments for a day, or for a period of up to 14 days
- Your Someday list (undated tasks)
- Your reminders, including shared lists you're a member of
- Appointments from shared calendars you're a member of

What ChatGPT can add and change, if you allow it:
- Add a task to a day, or to your Someday list
- Add an appointment, for example a test or exam
- Find free time before a test and add study sessions
- Tick off a task or reopen it, set its duration or a study session's time, or add a note to it

When you connect, you choose "View only" or "View and change". Only with "View and change" can ChatGPT make changes, and only when you ask for it or agree to it in the conversation. ChatGPT normally asks you to confirm a change, or you make it yourself with a tap in the Able to Plan card. ChatGPT cannot delete anything, and what it adds is marked "Via ChatGPT" in Able to Plan. Data is only fetched when ChatGPT needs it to answer you.

You stay in control. You connect by signing in with your Able to Plan account and confirming the connection. You get an in-app notification for every new connection, and you can switch AI assistant connections off or revoke all connections at any time in Able to Plan (Settings, AI assistant connections).

Requires an Able to Plan account. Available from age 13.

com.openai.release_notes: ChatGPT can now also add tasks, Someday tasks, appointments and study sessions, and tick off, reopen or update a task (its duration, a study session's time or an added note). Only for connections where you chose "View and change", and only when you ask for it or agree to it. Nothing can be deleted.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists today's tasks and appointments from the test account, appointments with start and end time, completed tasks marked as done.

positive.prompt: What does my week look like?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises tasks and appointments per day from Monday to Sunday of the current week.

positive.description: Free time on a given afternoon
positive.prompt: Do I have anything planned on Thursday afternoon?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Thursday's appointments after 12:00 with times (the test account has a performance review at 14:00), or says the afternoon is free.
Lists the undated tasks with their category, open tasks first.
Lists the open reminders with their list name, and the due time when one is set (the test account's reminders have none, so no times are shown); the completed reminder is not shown.

positive.prompt: Mark "Send follow-up email to supplier" as done.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the open task "Send follow-up email to supplier" on Wednesday of the current week and marks it as done. The change is made only after the user asked for it or confirmed it. Afterwards the task shows as completed.

positive.prompt: I didn't actually take my lunch walk on Tuesday. Can you set it back to open?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the completed task "Take a lunch walk" on Tuesday of the current week and sets it back to open. The change is made only after the user asked for it or confirmed it.

positive.prompt: The quarterly report will take longer. Set "Draft quarterly report" to 2 hours.
positive.expected_behavior: Changes the duration of "Draft quarterly report" (Wednesday of the current week, currently 90 minutes) to 120 minutes. The change is made only after the user asked for it or confirmed it. The task text and day stay the same.

positive.description: Add a task to a day
positive.prompt: Add "Book a table for team lunch" to my planner for Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the task "Book a table for team lunch" to Friday of the current week. The change is made only after the user asked for it or confirmed it. Friday then shows it next to "Deadline: submit project proposal" and "Write weekly review"; the new task is marked "Via ChatGPT".

positive.description: Add a task to the Someday list
positive.prompt: Put "Renew passport" on my Someday list.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds "Renew passport" to the Someday list without a date. The change is made only after the user asked for it or confirmed it. The Someday list then holds it next to "Request a new laptop from IT", "Look into training budget courses" and "Tidy up desk".

positive.description: Add a test as an appointment
positive.prompt: I have a Dutch language test on Thursday next week from 10:00 to 11:00. Put it in my agenda.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the appointment "Dutch language test" on Thursday of next week from 10:00 to 11:00, as a test (type exam). The change is made only after the user asked for it or confirmed it. The appointment's notes start with "Via ChatGPT".

positive.description: Plan study sessions for a test
positive.prompt: I have a Dutch test on Thursday next week at 10:00. Plan three 45-minute study sessions before it, one per day.
positive.expected_behavior: If the test is not in the planner yet, ChatGPT may first offer to add it as an appointment (create_appointment; the change is made only after the user confirmed it). It then looks up free time before the test (plan_study_sessions changes nothing) and proposes three 45-minute sessions on three different days before Thursday of next week, with date and time. After the user agrees, it shows them in an editable study plan card from which the user adds them with a tap, or adds them with create_study_session after the user confirmed. The sessions appear in the planner marked "Via ChatGPT". Nothing is added without the user's agreement.

negative.description: Deleting appointments (there is no delete tool)
negative.prompt: Delete all my appointments on Friday.

negative.description: Changing another member's items in a shared calendar
negative.prompt: Remove my colleague's meetings from our shared team calendar.
What's the weather in Amsterdam tomorrow?
